atoms.a: I have very sensitive skin. I need to use a very gentle soap which is not abrasive to avoid getting skin irritations.
Masada’s plan to move to France seemed ludicrous since she’d never been abroad. Now, she has lived there for 10 years and proved her sceptics wrong.
He used to be my best friend, but he turned into an obnoxious person who insults other people for no reason.
At first, I had a lot of doubts about my partner’s plan to adopt a child, but he brought up very persuasive points and changed my mind.
The politician’s affiliation with an unreliable organisation raised concerns about his authority.
